review: Kindly note the context: I administer a prayer rotation of forty people that begins at 4:45 every morning and has not missed a day in six years. Our difficulty has never been commitment; it is the twenty minutes between the opening and the intercessions, which we have always filled badly. This album fills it. Three points. One — "Bowls Before The Throne" is Revelation 5:8 and it gives people something to hold when their own words have run out, which at that hour is most people. Two — the pacing suits a room that is still waking up; nothing demands a response before anyone is able to give one. Three — I have built the whole of next month's rotation around it. What I need and cannot find is a way to share one playlist that forty people open at the same moment. We are currently doing this by forwarding a link every morning, which is absurd.
